item.title: JUMP CUT Short Film Turns Hollywood Ambition Into a Terrifying Sci-Fi Time Trap
item.description: Time anxiety hits hard in Jump Cut, a short sci-fi thriller that taps directly into the creeping dread of watching opportunities slip by while you’re still standing in the same place. Directed by James Martin Morrison, the film centers on Maya, a struggling actor in her 30s who feels trapped in a loop of auditions, rejection, and the gnawing fear that her window is closing.Maya’s life runs on hurry and hope. She races from one audition to the next, stuck in a career that refuses to move forward.
